params.dica.pattern: Regular expression, evaluated by the server.
params.dica.secret: Encrypted by the server. Cannot be created in local mode.
params.dica.reference: The value may only contain parameters marked as referenceable.
params.reference.semParams: This application has no other parameters to reference.
modo.local.explicacao: Writes to the local file. No network is used, and sensitive types are refused.
modo.remote.explicacao: Talks to the server. This is the default mode and the published behaviour.
estado.draft.explicacao: Created here and never sent to the server.
estado.dirty.explicacao: Existed on the server and has been changed since.
estado.conflict.explicacao: Changed on both sides. Nothing is sent without your decision.
estado.rejected.explicacao: The server refused it. The parameter is still stored here.
apps.excluir.texto: This deletes the application {nome} and its {total} parameter(s). This cannot be undone.
params.avisos.titulo: {total} catalogue warning(s) — the parameter was saved anyway:
params.tabela.legenda: Parameters of the selected application, with type and sync state.
params.semApp: Select an application on the left.
params.vazio: This application has no parameters yet.
params.dica.json: Enter JSON. The text is validated on save.
params.valorIlegivel: The value could not be read: {erro}
params.excluir.texto: This deletes the parameter {nome} from the application {app}. This cannot be undone.
sync.somenteLocal: Sync only exists in local mode: in remote mode every write already goes straight to the server.
sync.semPlano: No plan computed. Computing queries the server and writes nothing.
sync.nadaAEnviar: Nothing to send: everything is already synced.
sync.appsACriar: Applications that will be created first: {apps}
sync.aplicar.texto: {total} parameter(s) will be sent to the server. Unchecked conflicts are left out.
tipos.sensivel.explicacao: Encrypted by the server. Cannot be created in local mode.
tipos.defaults.explicacao: Applied by the server when the parameter carries no explicit limit. This is why a value can pass here and be refused there.
sessao.instancia.dica: Each instance has its own cache, local database and configuration.
sessao.modo.dica: Switching modes requires a new instance: a session already built is not reconfigured.
sessao.senha.dica: Used only to obtain the token. It is not stored here.
sessao.inativa: No session configured. Fill in the fields and connect.
sessao.erro.urlObrigatoria: Remote mode requires the API URL. Without it the session starts and every read fails.
sessao.dicaLocal: Local mode uses no network: parameters are written to a file on this machine.
sessao.modoNaoAplicado: Instance {instancia} already exists in {atual} mode and cannot be reconfigured to {pedido}. Use a new name to open a session in {pedido}.
sessao.avisoCustodia: The custody key is read from a global environment variable: one process holds exactly one key. Applications with different keys need different processes.
apps.campo.nome.dica: Spaces become hyphens: the name becomes part of the server address.
filtro.dica: Type to filter. Enter pins the term as a tag.
params.user.user_id.dica: Generated automatically and used as a reference. Not editable.
